gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-old-south-arab: Approachable and clean, the body text stays out of the way. Phudu draws every line as if with one marker tip, so it works best big and brief, with Noto Sans Old South Arabian, a plain sans, filling in the quieter text beneath it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Phudu lays down bold display letters whose stroke ends look cut from a single ribbon, loose and open at every curve. Noto Sans Shavian, the contemporary sans below, keeps long reading light and loose.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ojuju: Ojuju reads as approachable and contemporary, with wide s curves that barely curl in. Phudu earns its keep large and short, where its lines hold their width through every turn, while Ojuju's modest weight change in round letters stays gentler.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-palanquin: Phudu is a bold display face, every letter drawn with a flat, unvarying line and open curve endings. And Palanquin, the sans-serif body, keeps its own wide-mouthed curves and contemporary manner, so the page moves from loud to businesslike.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-philosopher: Philosopher reads clean and professional, with soft thickness shifts. Phudu earns its keep big and short, where its pen-like line of constant weight can show off against the sans-serif body's gently thinning bowls.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-pontano-sans: Contemporary and professional in the body, bold and distinctive up top: that is the split here. Phudu does its best work shouting in a single width, but Pontano Sans is the one that keeps wide open terminals comfortable in running text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-pt-sans: Every stroke of Phudu is flat and unvarying, with curve endings left generously open, which gives it a bold display look. And PT Sans, the sans-serif body, adds approachable arcs on its c forms, so a longer passage would read steadily beneath the heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-quattrocento-sans: Phudu builds its bold display letters from a monoline construction, with generous openings at every curve end. Quattrocento Sans, a plain sans, feels modern and clean beside it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans is professional and neutral, its e opened wide. Phudu's bold display letters sit over it, and a longer passage would still read smoothly in the sans, with thickness that does not change with direction.
